name: Paragons of Power: The Haruspex's Belt
label: Quest
description: Paragons of Power: The Haruspex's Belt: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: We Zandalar know not of druidic ways; nature is to be shaped by our need, not the other way around. Still, a haruspex is the one of us most in tune with nature, and rightly so. To give up the ghost of a beastie is to know what it is to be one of them. That is the real power of nature.
Bring me an offerin' of the Paragons of Power from inside Zul'Gurub, proving yourself to us. Do this, and I'll give ya a powerful item - a belt used by many of the Zandalar's haruspices.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Got the Paragons of Power from Zul'Gurub I need? The haruspex's belt will be yours if ya have them.

clips.title: Completion
paras: I thank you - the latent power in these items will be treasures unto themselves, you betcha. Not only have ya done as I've asked of ya, but you've also proven to be honorable to us here in the tribe. As promised, here is your reward!
